info.title: Roku Remote Server API
info.description: REST API for controlling Roku devices remotely via the Roku Dev Studio remote server. This server runs on a Mac Mini (or any computer) at a remote location and exposes Roku ECP (External Control Protocol) functionality over HTTP, along with telnet debug console and telnet system console streaming, a remote Network Inspector (MITM capture/replay/traffic rules), and a remote BrightScript socket debugger, both of which also stream live events over Server-Sent Events (SSE).

get.summary: Export raw packets as a PCAP file
get.description: Export raw captured frames as a .pcap file, optionally scoped to a comma-separated list of device IPs (all devices when omitted). Only frames actually captured on the local capture interface are included - MITM-only sessions may have nothing to export (see NetworkInspectorStatus.rawPacketsAvailable).
Get metadata about this server's MITM root CA certificate (used to decrypt HTTPS) and the proxy's listen address.
Download this server's MITM root CA certificate in PEM format, so a Roku device (or a browser) can be made to trust it.
Download this server's MITM root CA certificate in .crt (X.509 DER-ish) format.
Server-Sent Events stream of status updates and new event batches. Bodies are NOT included on the wire - fetch a specific event's full detail on demand via GET /network/event/{eventId}.

200.description: text/event-stream - a sequence of `data: {...}` frames, each `{"type": "status"|"events", "payload": ...}`

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream of debugger session events (state changes, stopped/suspended snapshots, console output, runtime errors, compile errors, breakpoint updates) across all attached devices. Returns 503 when the debug-session controller failed to load on this server.

post.description: Queue breakpoints for this session. Breakpoints only register on the device while it's halted - if the session is currently running, the request is echoed back as `pending` and the controller flushes it to the device at the next stop.
